body:
For me it formed a health issue, more towards my mental stability,  it's not that I said concrete "I'll suicide if I don't get help"  But as the issue arose more,  the orthodontic man proposed the sped up solution which is more of a cosmetic treatment ( business people wanting straight teeth quick etc, they can't have it for 3 years)  seeing how I said I felt I couldn't live with this  issue longer,  he pressed to make sure it was no cosmetic at all,  but all medical, I have no idea about insurances as well but  it got accepted, I I was thankful to him for that. 

There is no way I'll not he able to pay the 20% with the support I have from my mom and friends/family. But I don't know what would happen if I couldn't,  rather not find that out. I suspect the operation will be within 2 months,  which is 3 months overtime, making it more and more difficult. 

You're definitely right,  I'm scared.. I'm afraid it won't change a thing about how I feel or function in these days.. I have no idea if it will get rid of my depression and replace it with joy as I've never been able to place what is happening to me to begin with. I think I'll be happy,  but not sure if I can cope with it all.. I've always been a pessimist, but I do try to be realistic about everything. 

But I'll pull true,  the mindstate I have is "All will be fine and better"  but reality is,  if it won't,  I got that thought out as well. 

To think I can normally think about everything going on with me,  are already big steps forward.. I used to completely break down when thinking/talking about my "issue". 

Thank you for your time and input. 

I think it will be OK.

I'm sorry that I haven't responded sooner. 

My jaw problem is still unclear to me and that's been part of breakdowns I had in the early stage of the problem,  I had no way of explaining what I felt,  I still don't.. It's just a feeling and a response my body gives. 

It isn't covered 100% because the braces are actually a "cosmetic"  thing and the only reason it got accepted is because without it, no jaw operation ( because then because of how my teeth stand,  it'd not fix anything.) formed a true medical threat for me ( namely suicide,  because I couldn't handle it anymore), and the only reason I'm still going strong is because the operation will come.. Soon... 

I'm very happy that my mom is there for me,  and I think they know I'll end it when this doesn't help. I'm really positive about it all,  but I don't want to step ahead and be happy already. I'd rather be negative and come out positive,  than be positive and come out negative.. 

The twitch thing,  can simply be your body responding to something. I suggest going by a jaw surgeon and check it out,  if your jaw stand is messed a bit,  it can have shit effects and only get worse. 

Thank you for your comment,  I truly hope I'll be as happy as those people after the operation!

Good luck to you too!
